dispute_ticket.description: My ride was booked for 12.10pm. By 12.16 there was no driver at my block so I cancelled, and I still got charged S$4.00. I waited nearly 7 minutes. Please refund me.

chat_logs.content: Sorry, road closed, about 8 more mins.
Trip cancelled by rider. Cancellation fee of $4.00 applied.

app_events.details: Rider R-8109 booked advance trip RYDE-PX-009 for 12:10. Driver D-7109 matched at 11:50.
Rider cancelled. Driver had not arrived. Seconds elapsed since scheduled pickup: 405. No driver_arrived event recorded.
$4.00 cancellation fee charged to rider payment method (credit card).

cancellation_fee_rider.text: The fee in SGD charged to a rider who cancels outside the free cancellation window.

free_cancellation_within_min_of_match.text: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee.

driver_not_arrived_free_cancel_s.text: Seconds, counted from scheduled_time, after which a rider may cancel without fee if no driver_arrived event exists. The value is in SECONDS (300 s = 5 minutes). The limit is exclusive: cancelling after more than this many seconds is free.

expected_outcome.reason: Cancellation at 12:16:45 is 405 seconds after the 12:10:00 scheduled pickup, as the event also states. This trip's limit is 300 seconds (5 minutes) with no driver_arrived event, so the rider cancelled free and the S$4.00 fee is unjustified. GPS shows the driver still en_route and the driver's chat admits 8 more minutes.
expected_official_sections: Ryde Help Rider Fares And Charges > Cancellation and Waiting Fee
